title: Singular Points on Positroid Varieties and Planar N=4 Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Theory
summary: Positroid varieties $Π_f$ provide a decomposition of the Grassmannian $Gr(k,n)$; they can be enumerated using bounded affine permutations ($f$) which have bijections with a number of interesting combinatorial objects. Furthermore, (the nonnegative part of) positroid varieties parameterize the space that is integrated over when calculating amplitudes in planar N=4 supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory.
